event_chain.summary: Nurse downloaded patient data without authorization

summary: NSW Police were told on July 22, 2026 that a Northern Sydney Local Health District employee had accessed and downloaded patient data without authorization. Cybercrime Squad detectives searched his Frenchs Forest home on July 23, seized devices holding patient details and charged the 59-year-old nurse with accessing restricted data held in a computer. Early inquiries suggested the data stayed with him.
